source.quote: 1.资助类别:旅游管理专业硕士研究生 2.授课语言:中文 三、资助内容和标准 1.学费:资助标准参照现行中国政府奖学金标准执行。 2.住宿费:为奖学金生提供免费宿舍,一般为 2-3 人间。 3.生活费:由学校按月发放;发放标准参照现行中国政府奖学金标准执行。 4.综合医疗保险:按照国家有关规定,为奖学金生购买医疗保险。 四、申请途径和时间 1.申请途径 申请者访问 “留学中国”网站,点击“中国政府奖学金来华留学管理信息系统”进入申请系统。“留学中国”网站链接: https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn/#/register , 注册账户成功后登录系统进行申请。 2.申请时间 202 6 年 4月 29 日 - 202 6 年 5月 25 日。 注:贵州师范大学 “受理机构编号”为10663,“留学项目种类”请选择“B类” 五、联系方式 联系人:柳老师 联系电话: 86-851-86759517 邮箱: lxs@gznu.edu.cn Notice on Application for the GZNU 2026/2027 Academic Year Silk Road Program of Chinese Government Scholarship GZNU 2026/2027 “ Silk Road Program ” of Chinese Government Scholarship is designed to recruit outstanding international students from countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative to pursue studies at Guizhou Normal University. The relevant application details are hereby announced as follows: I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens from Belt and Road partner countries, including but not limited to Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, Myanmar, Russia, Uganda, and be in good physical and mental health; 2. Applicants must demonstrate good moral character and have no record of criminal or improper conduct; 3. Applicants must have achieved HSK Level 4 or above; 4. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree, have an excellent academic record, and generally be under the age of 35. II. Scholarship Category and Language of Instruction 1. Scholarship Category: Master’s Program in Tourism Management
